title: REDACTED
description: A resource pack that redacts the whole font, so Minecraft looks like Epstein files!
body:
# REDACTED

**REDACTED** is a Minecraft texture pack that completely censors the entire in-game font — turning every piece of text into bold white redaction bars.

The result? Your world looks like a fully classified document straight out of the *Epstein Files*. Menus, chat, item names, tooltips — everything is ███████.

No readable text.  
No mercy.  
Just pure redacted energy.

---

## ✦ Versions

### 🤍 WhiteRedact
All text is replaced with **white redaction bars**.  
Clean, inverted, high-contrast censorship.

### 📜 LegacyREDACTED
A legacy edition of REDACTED designed for **Minecraft 1.8.x–1.16.x**.  
Brings the same full white-font censorship to older versions of the game.

---

## ✦ Features

- Replaces the entire Minecraft font
- Works in menus, chat, inventories, tooltips, and more
- Minimalistic but chaotic visual experience
- Lightweight — no performance impact

---

Turn your Minecraft into a fully classified government document.

Everything is hidden.  
Everything is ███████.
